notes.title: Pirate Survivors Playtest Update #6
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys!

It's been a little while and we've mostly been working on some (still hidden) UI pages 😅
But we still got a slew of new changes for you to test and give us your feedback on!

Please let us know how you like the new balancing and the revamped upgrades screen!
Can't wait to share more updates with you very very soon 🏴‍☠️

Daivid.

notes.title: New playtest update!
notes.content: [h1]Pirate Survivors Playtest Update #5![/h1][p]Hey pirates! 🏴‍☠️[/p][p]It's been a little over a month since the last playtest patch so we felt it was appropriate to call this one a full on update 😅[/p][p]We hope it really show the month of work we put on for these changes, as they include:[/p][list][*][p]New sound effects for menus, hitting enemies, some weapons and collecting coins ✨[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked visual effects for smoke and fire 🔥[/p][/*][*][p]New looks for the upgrade menus and quality of life changes to the chest menus 🪙[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep sharing your feedback with us as we're getting closer and closer to a polished demo, it really helps guide the game in the direction you'll enjoy the most 🙌[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605316/83d7d886429850a8344fefbdd31985fa4c855d94.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update #4!
notes.content:
Ahoy pirates! 🏴‍☠️

We're happy to share this huge milestone with you all!

We finally got the art for all upgrades finished! Alongside:
* Splitting boss variation to a second boss fight and making it a requirement for beating the game
* New visuals for relic abilities

This should now free us up to work more on polishing the rest of the UI for a more complete experience.
Thank you all for playing!

tags.feature: * Splitting boss variation to a second boss fight and making it a requirement for beating the game

notes.title: Playtest Patch #3
notes.content:
Dear pirates! 🏴‍☠️

After a week of work we bring a new update to the playtest!

With this patch we focus on new content to keep the game engaging!
* Added win screen after 20 minutes of surviving
* Optional Endless mode getting harder and harder by the minute after winning
* Up to 9 Curse levels for different difficulties!
* New upgrades artwork

We hope these changes will help make the game more enjoyable, please share more of your feedback with us to help improve the game as we go. 🙏
